facts.fact: The Brief reports a Draft AI Bill under development to establish ethical standards and accountability mechanisms for AI deployment, and a Cybercrime Bill aimed at countering AI-related threats.

NAM.note: The document states no government use of an AI system.

facts.fact: The Brief says that as of January 2026 Namibia has no comprehensive enacted AI-specific legislation and a Draft AI Bill is under development.

NAM.note: The document states no AI tool in a public sector system.

facts.fact: The Brief says Namibia has a recently launched National AI Strategy that promotes ethical AI adoption across key sectors through a decentralised approach.

NAM.note: The document states no AI model, dataset or computing built in the country.

facts.fact: The Brief names a Cybercrime Bill that aims to counter technology-enabled and AI-related threats, as of January 2026.
The Brief names the Data Protection Bill of 2023 as complementary legislation on data privacy, without saying it is enacted.
